session.title: Switchy 1.0.32: Claude errors stay on the serving account; configured quota rotation preserved
session.purpose: Diagnose the user's current Claude 429 and its proxy route, then remove error-triggered account failover and recovery throttling while preserving his configured quota rotation and visible account switching; build and install the fix locally.
outcomes: Diagnosed the misleading 429: Owen still had quota (88% five-hour, 11% weekly). Repeated connection failures tripped its breaker after 8 failures; recovery admitted only one request at a time while other requests tried the three accounts already at 100% weekly usage. Those accounts returned Anthropic's 429, so the displayed error did not establish that Owen was exhausted.

Confirmed route ownership: Owen has its own SOCKS5 proxy at 82.26.163.142:45001. The other three Claude providers have no own proxy, and the global outbound proxy is unset, so their API attempts connect directly. Failover API requests do not inherit Owen's proxy. Claude's separate CONNECT login/telemetry traffic follows the currently selected account; the user agreed this design is correct.

the user's final direction: preserve configured quota rotation and its visible account changes; remove error-triggered hidden fallback and restrictions on the selected account. The threshold is user-configurable, currently 99%, not a hardcoded 99% rule. An initial interpretation that removed proactive rotation was corrected before installation. Existing manual-pick holds and the visible account/login/window/tray switching path are preserved.

Implemented Claude-only behavior in a6b260738b7d6f672fc231b3797536bd6d4035a3: selection and admission ignore Claude circuit breakers, failed requests do not restrict later requests or concurrency, and connection/login/service/config/request errors stay on the account serving the request. Passing connection faults retry once on that route. Exhausted account/model quota can still try a fallback; quota ordering still uses AccountPoolConfig.threshold_percent. Codex and the other tools retain their behavior.

Updated settings text in English, Chinese and Japanese; hid retry/circuit-breaker controls that no longer apply to Claude. Updated README, DECISION_LOG and Unreleased changelog. Version files and Windows installers are 1.0.32. The build procedure pruned superseded 1.0.31 Windows installers and bundles; the 1.0.30 macOS DMG remains.

Verification: local HTTP regressions proved 502 retries the same endpoint twice without contacting fallback, 401 and per-minute 429 stay there, and an account-quota 429 contacts the next endpoint. Router regression proved an old open breaker does not exclude/throttle Claude and changing the configured threshold from 80% to 95% changes rotation for an account at 88% usage. Initial full lib run passed 744 tests with the known port-15721 test excluded; after the threshold correction, cargo test --lib proxy:: -- --test-threads=1 passed 492 tests. pnpm typecheck and CI=true pnpm build passed.

Installed 1.0.32 on this workstation with stop, /S install, explorer relaunch and the port-15721 wait in one command. Installed executable reports 1.0.32; control route confirmed rotation enabled, configured threshold 99, Owen selected and first. Native Claude traffic recorded HTTP 200 on Owen at 2026-10-11 22:18:22 UTC. A synthetic request using an outdated claude-cli/2.1.2 user-agent was refused with HTTP 400 and stayed on Owen, with no fallback. The installed Claude CLI is 2.1.296; that synthetic rejection was a client-version check, not a routing fault.

SW106 is done and accepted in Workstate. Implementation/installers are committed on main as a6b26073; nothing pushed, no public release, and no installs on other machines this session. The live configured threshold was not changed. Previously pending checks from session_22 were not claimed complete.

In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log and the switchy.db account_switches table: (a) when an account's five-hour window resets while another serves, a switch back to it with reason 'recovered' and detail "Another account's weekly limit resets sooner"; (b) a Codex turn refused for usage that continues an earlier one logs '[CodexWS] provider=... websocket closed (turn refused for usage; Codex resends it in full)' and the turn then completes on the next account with no error in Codex. GET http://127.0.0.1:15721/switchy/accounts shows current account, pool order, quota and atLimit per account.

1.0.30 (manual sign-in), 1.0.31 (account proxy and unsigned-account usage), and 1.0.32 (Claude errors stay on the serving account; configured quota rotation retained) are unreleased: the public release is still 1.0.29, installers/ holds the 1.0.32 Windows installers and the 1.0.30 DMG, and the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section has no version heading yet. Release only when the user asks. Wait for the user's feedback on 1.0.32 (Claude request errors and quota switching), 1.0.29 (start at login, restart hand-back), 1.0.28 (codex resume with permission flags; terminals need reopening), 1.0.27 (WSL login sync, \\wsl.localhost fallback) and 1.0.22-1.0.26. A release is: bump the four version files, changelog section, CI=true pnpm build, commit, push origin, run scripts/publish_public.sh BEFORE the macOS build (the workflow builds the public repo), run build-macos.yml (gh workflow run build-macos.yml -R registered2nd/switchy --ref main), download its DMG into installers/ (git mv the old one to the new name, then copy over it) with the macOS line in the changelog section, commit, push, publish again, then gh release create on registered2nd/switchy with the exe, msi and dmg as a draft and edit to --draft=false --latest; retry on 'error connecting to api.github.com'. Reinstall here: stop switchy, wait until the process is gone, /S, relaunch, wait for 15721, all in one command.

VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.
